hero.subtitle: Hello, I'm Flavio, but you can call me Limão. I help teams build multi-agent systems and knowledge bases around one fixed idea: AI that gives autonomy back to people.

story.title: When life gives you lemons...
story.stamp: made of who i am · not just code ·
paragraphs: As a kid, I had a friend everyone called "Alemão" (German). I thought it was so cool — being known for something beyond just your name.

I knew it would never make sense for people to call me German. But I loved lemon popsicles, so I thought: "why not Limão (Lemon)?" I tried it. It did not stick. I asked for it. It got worse. That is not how nicknames work.

Years later, I decided to introduce myself starting from the first time I tried to be different. On my first website, I told this story around the idea that "when life gives you lemons...", and for the first time, I let my personality show without a filter.

That website is what led a company — with the ambition of going AI first, right at the start of the ChatGPT era — to find me. They were looking for an AI engineer. They found someone who insisted on thinking differently.
That is when Limão stopped being just an attempt at a nickname and became an identity.
story.punchline: In the end, they did not just hire an AI engineer. They hired Limão.
story.quote: There is no technology without a product, and no product without people. When people are free to be themselves, they deliver what only they could build.

roles.summary: Helping weave AI through an entire company.
bullets: Help design and ship multi-agent systems and evaluation harnesses across the company's products.
Collaborate on the knowledge bases that ground product and support decisions.
Support the definition of responsible-AI practices, measured by outcomes, quality, and the autonomy they hand back to the team.

roles.summary: Joined at month three, when customer support was still 100% human.
bullets: Helped introduce AI as a layer that backed the human team instead of replacing it.
Took part in building the multi-agent architecture that carried support through the company's growth.
This is where "Limão" stopped being an attempt at a nickname and became an identity.

roles.summary: The data team's utility player, across dozens of different domains.
bullets: Contributed to short-cycle deep learning projects in wildly different contexts, back to back.
Moved into AI agent work back in the early ChatGPT era and decided right there that this was the specialty worth committing to.

roles.summary: Internship and undergraduate research while completing a degree in Engineering Physics.
bullets: Took part in applied research at one of Brazil's leading science and technology centers.
Came close to an academic career and chose a different path: I wanted what I build to reach people's hands, sooner.
